init_quest_data_provider: create a QuestDataProvider instance from a VRS file and device calibration JSON path
get_device_calibration: get the factory device calibration object containing all sensor calibrations from the provider
get_camera_calibration: get the camera calibration extrinsics and intrinsics for a given stream ID and model
get_frameset_from_timestamp: compute a synchronized frameset dictionary mapping stream IDs to closest timestamps within a time window
get_undistorted_image: get the undistorted pinhole image for a given timestamp and stream ID from the VRS file
